_说明: viewer3d.html?model=pm_residence 的清单（标准档 pm_residence.glb + 低档 pm_residence_low.glb）。坐标 = glTF（Y 朝上，米；Blender (x, y, z) → (x, z, -y)）。由 blender/landmarks/pm_residence/build.py + blender/landmarks/export_glb.py 生成。

credit.zh: 自建模型；贴图 Poly Haven / ambientCG（CC0）
credit.en: Own model; textures Poly Haven / ambientCG (CC0)

desc.zh: 三栋深色伦敦砖联排，每栋各有自己的门，檐口与女儿墙高低错开 0.3–0.6 m，分户墙处砖墩凸出；四层窗按层递减（首层主厅层最高、顶层近方形），白框六格推拉窗退进墙面约 0.1 m，配石窗台和砖平拱；石压顶女儿墙挡住后面的矮坡板岩屋顶，只露出少数退后的老虎窗。
desc.en: Three dark London-stock brick houses, each with its own door; cornice and parapet heights step by 0.3–0.6 m with brick piers proud at the party walls. Four window rows diminish upward (tallest on the piano nobile, near-square at the top), white six-over-six sashes set back about 0.1 m with stone sills and flat brick arches; a stone-coped parapet hides a low slate roof with a few set-back dormers.

desc.zh: 黑漆六镶板门，白色门套（壁柱 + 檐部）、半圆扇形气窗、门环，门上方弯臂架挑出一盏铸铁灯笼。门前三级石阶跨过采光井。
desc.en: A black six-panel door in a white doorcase (pilasters and entablature) with a semicircular fanlight and knocker; a cast-iron lantern hangs from a bracket above. Three stone steps bridge the basement area.

desc.zh: 人行道和地下室采光井之间的铸铁矛头栏杆，门前台阶两侧另有短栏杆。
desc.en: Cast-iron spear-headed railings between the pavement and the basement lightwell, with short returns beside the front steps.

desc.zh: 分户墙上的砖烟囱，石压顶上各立三只陶土烟囱帽。
desc.en: Brick stacks on the party walls, each with a stone cap and three clay pots.

desc.zh: 街口的高铸铁门横跨人行道和车道，门外有路障桩；旁边一座黑漆木岗亭，板岩四坡顶。沿街是铸铁街灯。
desc.en: Tall cast-iron gates close the street end across both pavement and roadway, with bollards in front; beside them stands a black-painted timber sentry box under a slate hipped roof. Cast-iron lamp posts line the street.

desc.zh: 花园一侧的白色灰泥柱廊：台基上 14 根柱承托檐部，上面是宝瓶栏杆阳台，后面是落地窗。
desc.en: On the garden side, a white stucco colonnade: 14 columns on a podium carry an entablature and a balustraded balcony, with French windows behind.

desc.zh: 砖墙围起的草坪花园，中间一条砾石路，有树和修剪的矮树篱。
desc.en: A walled lawn garden with a gravel walk, trees and clipped low hedges.

desc.zh: 岛缘西侧伸出的钢结构停靠平台，只供悬浮载具起降：斜撑回接岩体、四周栏杆和引导灯柱、漆绘着陆圈（无文字）；一条短短的专用车道经铁门通到正门。岛外没有公共交通。
desc.en: A steel docking platform cantilevered off the island rim for hover vehicles only: braced back to the rock, with railings, guide-light posts and a painted landing ring (no lettering); a short private drive leads through the gate to the front doors. There is no public transport off the island.
